reviews.reason: Actors, prohibited conduct, coordination definition, same-owner and licensed-agent exemptions, primary-residence and facility exclusions, and the separate no-facilitation provision all match the cited text. No date claims. Definitions come from the companion ordinance, which the amending ordinance leaves unchanged.

Subsection (b) coercion, the definitions (common pricing algorithm, distribute, person excluding end consumers) and the separate subsection (a) conspiracy prohibition are accurately stated. The explanation says it is not a rental-specific ban and makes no date claims.

The passage allows charging the credit report cost and requesting reasonable application fees or employment verification. Employment verification is not described as a fee, and the explanation limits itself to the passage without any global no-cap claim.

Over-10% year-over-year renewal threshold, current-tenant scope, timing before implementation, placement in the lease's first page or the Division form, all four disclosures including the conditional tenant-paid right to take legal action, and the $1,000 per incident fine match the ordinance. The explanation says it is not a cap on increases.
